name: video-workflow-kit
description: Hebrew-first AI video production workflow for Claude Code: skills, plugins, packages and rules.
note_for_claude: Read START-HERE-FOR-CLAUDE.md first. Install group by group, ask the user before each group, never print or request secret values in chat.

own_skills.why_together: Skills reference each other by relative path .claude/skills/<name>/scripts/...

items.video-with-claude: Orchestrator: intake questions, script table, 'go' gate, routing, iron rules
items.ai-api-setup: API keys, env vars, network, quotas
items.hebrew-narration: Niqqud, Gemini TTS, ASR check, single-word fix
items.keyframe-images: Key images, style lock, character consistency, Hebrew text in images
items.video-motion-transitions: Image to video (Veo + camera fallback), 25 transitions, assembly
items.html-to-video: Deterministic HTML/GSAP explainer video, cues from transcript
items.video-qa-delivery: QA, contact sheet, split under 30MB, audio export
items.install-skill-from-url: Workflow for turning a docs link or repo into a project skill

hyperframes_skills.provides: hyperframes, hyperframes-cli, hyperframes-core, hyperframes-animation, hyperframes-audio, hyperframes-creative, hyperframes-keyframes, hyperframes-registry, hyperframes-studio, media-use, motion-graphics, general-video, faceless-explainer, music-to-video, talking-head-recut, embedded-captions, slideshow, product-launch-video, pr-to-video, figma, remotion-to-hyperframes
hyperframes_skills.license_note: Third-party (HeyGen). Not bundled; installed from source.

google_skills_selected.command: npx --yes skills add google/skills --skill gemini-api --skill gemini-live-api --skill gemini-interactions-api --skill finding-google-skills -y
google_skills_selected.warning: Do NOT install all of google/skills (178 skills): it bloats every session's context.
google_skills_selected.license_note: Third-party (Google). Not bundled; installed from source.

system_requirements.optional_hebrew_local_asr_model: ivrit-ai/whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2 (about 1.6 GB; not required, Gemini ASR is the default)

secrets.rule: Never paste a key in chat. Put it in the environment's secrets / env vars, then start a new session.

do_not_install.OmniRoute: Third-party AI gateway, not an Anthropic plugin; routes prompts and keys through a local proxy. Judged a security risk.
do_not_install.anidoodle: Not installed: competes with keyframe-images, 95 MB, no independent reviews found.
do_not_install.arcads-cut: Skill file never reviewed. Read any external zip before installing.
